records.title: Map values between same-named enums
records.summary: TypeScript 5.4 rejects assigning same-named enums when known member values differ.
conditions: Two distinct enum declarations have the same name and member names with different numeric values.
actions: Translate values explicitly at the boundary and handle every externally supplied value.
verification: Rerun the owning typecheck and test the mapping for each stable enum value.

records.title: Preserve intended writes to a filtered array
records.summary: TypeScript 5.5 narrows filter results for inferred type predicates. A later push of undefined can report TS2345.
conditions: An array filtered for defined values intentionally accepts undefined in later writes.
actions: Declare the result as the intended wider mutable array. If undefined is unintended, remove the write instead.
verification: Rerun typecheck and test the code that consumes the mutated result.

records.title: Check iterator completion before using value
records.summary: TypeScript 5.6 with strict mode types a built-in iterator's completion value as undefined.
conditions: The owning project enables strictBuiltinIteratorReturn and uses a built-in iterator's next().value without checking done.
actions: Branch on done and handle an exhausted iterator explicitly before reading value.
verification: Run typecheck and test both nonempty and exhausted iterators.

records.title: Initialize values read by nested functions
records.summary: TypeScript 5.7 diagnoses variables read by a nested function if they are never initialized.
conditions: A nested callback or function reads a strictly typed variable that was declared without an initializer and never assigned.
actions: Set a valid initial value or move the read after initialization.
verification: Run the owning typecheck and exercise the callback at its earliest invocation.

records.title: Use import attributes for NodeNext JSON imports
records.summary: TypeScript 5.8 reports TS2880 for a static JSON import with an import assertion under NodeNext.
conditions: An ESM file in a NodeNext project uses import ... assert { type: 'json' }.
actions: Replace assert with with and verify the runtime accepts import attributes.
verification: Run the owning typecheck and load the emitted module using the target Node version.

records.title: Use ArrayBuffer-backed bytes for Blob parts
records.summary: TypeScript 5.9 rejects a Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike> in a BlobPart position.
conditions: The project types input as Uint8Array and passes it to a DOM API requiring ArrayBuffer-backed bytes.
actions: Keep the narrower buffer type if guaranteed, or copy the view with new Uint8Array(bytes) before creating the Blob.
verification: Rerun typecheck and verify that the Blob preserves the incoming byte range.

records.title: Replace baseUrl with explicit paths mappings
records.summary: TypeScript 7 rejects baseUrl, and a relative paths mapping resolves the same source module in the fixture.
conditions: An effective tsconfig uses baseUrl for nonrelative imports from the source tree.
actions: Remove baseUrl and its obsolete ignoreDeprecations override. Add explicit paths prefixes anchored at the owning tsconfig.
verification: Run typecheck and confirm the bundler or runtime resolves the same aliases.

records.title: Replace legacy route glob metacharacters
records.summary: Playwright 1.52 no longer treats ? and bracket classes as wildcards in route URL globs.
conditions: The suite relies on ? or a bracket class as a wildcard in page.route or browserContext.route.
actions: Replace the affected glob with a scoped RegExp and keep exact host and path constraints.
verification: Run the route test against a matching URL and a nearby URL that should not be intercepted.

records.title: Replace legacy route glob metacharacters in React CT
records.summary: Playwright React 17 component testing resolves the same 1.52 route matcher, which stops treating ? and [] as wildcards.
conditions: A React 17 component test uses page.route or browserContext.route with these glob metacharacters.
actions: Replace affected globs with scoped regular expressions.
verification: Run the component route test with matching and excluded URLs.

records.title: Replace removed Page accessibility snapshots
records.summary: Playwright 1.57 removes page.accessibility. Locator.ariaSnapshot sends a scoped selector and returns a YAML snapshot.
conditions: The suite calls page.accessibility.snapshot and uses its result to assert the roles and accessible names within a known region.
actions: Use Locator.ariaSnapshot for the same region and review the new snapshot expectations. Use a rule-based accessibility test for audit intent.
verification: Rebaseline the owning Playwright snapshot and verify its region, roles, and accessible names in the browser.
